jobs.description:
At SEPHORA UK, beauty isn’t just what we sell - it’s who we are. It’s the freedom to express yourself, the thrill of discovering something new, and the power of belonging to a community that celebrates every identity. From our beginnings in France to becoming part of the LVMH family, we’ve always pushed boundaries through creativity, innovation, and inclusivity.
  
  
Today, as we continue our exciting expansion across the UK, we’re looking for passionate, driven individuals to help shape the future of prestige beauty in one of the world’s most dynamic retail markets. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and love bringing ideas to life through impactful campaigns, this is your moment.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As our Brand Marketing Manager, you’ll play a central role in accelerating the growth of SEPHORA UK’s surge and priority brands, including our exclusive Only at SEPHORA portfolio. Reporting to the Senior Brand Marketing Manager, you’ll translate shared ambitions into compelling omnichannel marketing plans that build brand visibility, engage our customers and deliver commercial growth.
  
  
You’ll become a trusted strategic partner to your brands, leading launches and ongoing marketing programmes from planning through to performance review. * Build trusted partnerships with assigned surge and priority brands, aligning marketing activity with shared commercial objectives.
* Lead the end-to-end planning and delivery of 360-degree omnichannel launches, tailored to each brand’s identity and ambitions.
* Act as the central point of contact for internal stakeholders, coordinating cross-functional taskforces and keeping activity on track.
* Partner with wider Marketing teams to identify opportunities that strengthen launches and support sustained brand growth.
* Manage campaign assets, timelines and approvals, ensuring every activation meets SEPHORA and partner brand guidelines.
* Present launch strategies, marketing plans and progress updates to senior leadership and the wider business.
* Track campaign performance, sales, traffic, sell-through and promotional return on investment to identify opportunities for optimisation.
* Create clear post-campaign reports and strategic recommendations for brand partners, internal leadership and Global teams.
* Collaborate with Digital and Media teams to optimise paid search, paid social, affiliate activity and brand visibility.
* Support annual and global marketing priorities, including the planning and coordination of First at SEPHORA launches.
* Own brand incubation, co-op and local marketing budgets, allocating investment to maximise impact and commercial return.
* Manage external agency relationships across media, events and production, ensuring activity is delivered on time, on brand and within budget.

**What You’ll Bring…**
You’ll be a commercially minded and highly collaborative marketer who knows how to turn strong partnerships into impactful campaigns. Strategic and creative in your thinking, you’ll combine excellent relationship management with the organisation, attention to detail and influencing skills needed to bring multiple teams together and deliver ambitious plans.
  
  

* Strong experience in brand marketing, account management or retail marketing, ideally gained within beauty, luxury, FMCG or another consumer-focused environment.
* Experience building and managing successful relationships with external brand partners and internal stakeholders.
* A proven ability to lead integrated, omnichannel campaigns from initial concept through to launch and performance review.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to coordinate complex campaigns, competing priorities and multiple contributors.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to influence across functions, countries and levels of seniority.
* Commercial and analytical capability, with experience using sales, campaign and digital marketing performance to inform decisions.
* Experience managing marketing budgets and using insights to improve investment and return.
* A strong understanding of digital and retail marketing channels, including paid search, paid social and affiliate marketing.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with the ability to create clear plans, presentations and performance reports.
* A degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration or a related subject would be beneficial, alongside a genuine interest in the beauty industry and its evolving trends.

**Beautiful Benefits At SEPHORA UK**
When you join SEPHORA, you’re joining a team that we truly value and our benefits reflect that. Here’s what you can look forward to:
  
  

* Private Healthcare, Life Assurance and Private Pension from day one.
* Competitive pay that grows with you, including annual salary reviews.
* A generous employee discount across the world’s best beauty brands.
* A paid day off on your birthday.
* Access to a wellbeing and perks platform.
* LVMH Heart Fund support.
* Generous holiday allowance, with the option to buy more.
* And more…

***Together, we belong to something beautiful.***

SEPHORA is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace for all. We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, or other employment practices. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating and fostering an inclusive environment for all employees.
  
  
We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates. Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role, so applicants must have the right to work in the UK at the start of employment and will be asked to provide relevant evidence.

Joybuy is JD.com's European online retail business, bringing JD.com's extensive retail, technology and supply chain expertise to European consumers.

Operating through both 1P and 3P business models, Joybuy combines its own retail operations with a growing marketplace ecosystem, offering consumers a broad selection of products from leading international, European and local brands.

Currently operating across the UK, Germany, France, the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg, Joybuy is continuing to expand its European footprint, with plans to enter Spain, Portugal and Italy in 2027.

Supported by JD.com's extensive supply chain capabilities, local warehousing and delivery infrastructure, Joybuy is committed to providing European consumers with quality products, competitive prices and a convenient shopping experience.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for a commercially driven European Campaign Lead to take ownership of Joybuy's biggest shopping events, including Black Friday, Christmas and Summer Sales.

This is a high-impact role at the intersection of merchandising, marketing and commercial operations. You will lead campaign planning and execution across multiple European markets, bringing cross-functional teams together to deliver strong commercial results.

You will act as both a strategic campaign owner and hands-on operator, with direct accountability for campaign sales performance across four or more European markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

* End-to-End Campaign Ownership: Lead the planning, coordination and execution of major campaigns, from initial briefing and strategy development to implementation and post-campaign performance reviews.
* Commercial & Merchandising Strategy: Work closely with merchandising, cross-border procurement and country operations teams to drive product selection, inventory planning, pricing strategies and promotional mechanics.
* Promotional Strategy: Develop and implement effective promotional frameworks, including coupon structures, bundle deals, flash sales and tiered discounts, ensuring clear commercial objectives and ROI logic.
* Multi-Market Coordination: Drive campaign execution across the UK, Germany, France and the Netherlands, while adapting strategies to local market dynamics and consumer behaviours.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the central PMO for campaign delivery, aligning stakeholders, tracking milestones, identifying blockers and driving timely decision-making.
* Sales Performance Ownership: Take direct accountability for campaign sales targets, monitor performance against objectives and proactively drive actions to maximise commercial results.

**Requirements**

* 8–12 years of experience in e-commerce operations, campaign management, commercial planning or a related field.
* Strong understanding of e-commerce business fundamentals, including merchandising, product selection, pricing, promotions and inventory management.
* Proven track record of planning and delivering large-scale e-commerce campaigns end-to-end.
* Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to translate campaign strategies into measurable business results.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset, taking accountability for outcomes rather than focusing solely on process coordination.
* Comfortable leveraging AI tools to improve productivity, data analysis and operational efficiency.
* Fluent in English and proficient in Chinese, with the ability to communicate effectively with HQ and China-based teams.
* Previous experience within an e-commerce platform or marketplace is highly preferred.

**Why Join Joybuy?**

* Build Something at Scale: Be part of JD.com's ambitious expansion in Europe and help shape the future of its online retail and marketplace business.
* Real Business Ownership: Take direct ownership of major European campaigns and their commercial performance.
* International Exposure: Work closely with cross-functional teams across Europe and China, operating in a truly international environment.
* High Business Impact: Play a key role in driving Joybuy's growth, customer acquisition and sales performance across multiple European markets.
* Growth Opportunities: Join a rapidly expanding business with further European market launches planned for 2027.

jobs.description:
Living Things is one of the fastest-growing drinks brands in the UK, with listings in every major grocer, the best independents, and 20+ international markets. We're less than three years into our mission to make soft drinks that are delicious and guilt-free and we're growing our team.

We're looking for people who want real ownership and the chance to build one of Europe's defining consumer brands.The Content & Social Manager plays a key role in bringing the Living Things brand world to life online, owning our channel strategy and content to build a genuine community of soda lovers around Living Things.

Reporting to the Head of Marketing, and line managing the Marketing & Partnerships Executive, this role is accountable for growing our social presence, creating the most culturally relevant content and partnerships, and supporting sampling, trade and NPD moments with best-in-class social activation.

The Content & Social Manager will own social end-to-end, from content strategy and calendar through to creation, community management and performance reporting, working with structure, pace and independence as we scale. Collaborating closely with the marketing team as well as the wider business and our partners, this role will lead social ideation and creation, shaping social-first concepts and content that brings our key campaigns, standalone tactical moments and brand collaborations to life online.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Channel Strategy & Content Creation**

* Create content that tells our story, building out the Living Things brand world online and attracting an audience who want to follow our journey.
* Own the organic social strategy across Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn, developing platform-specific approaches that grow our community of soda lovers and drive engagement
* Co-own the Living Things Tone of Voice, ensuring it is expressed across all digital touchpoints
* Develop social campaigns that support strong launches with key customers and champion our independent stockists through an ongoing programme of content support
* Ensure all brand activations are well covered on social, positioning Living Things as the most culturally relevant brand in our category

**2. Community & Performance**

* Own community management (DMs and comments) with clear timeframes and consistent, accountable execution
* Track, analyse and report on channel performance, using insight to continuously test, learn and refine our content approach
* Work closely with our brand experience team to ensure activations are planned and executed with social media impact in mind, contributing ideas at the planning stage and supporting delivery in a way that maximises reach and engagement

**3. Partnerships & Influencer Marketing**

* Line manage our Marketing & Partnerships Executive, scaling and crystallising our influencer programme into a more structured, strategic approach
* Work together to Identify and arrange collaborations with great-fit creators, and brands, working strategically on the best way to engage them, from events to send-outs
* Help establish our brand ambassador programme from the ground up, starting small and building out as we learn what works

  
**Requirements**  

* This role blends creative, strategy and implementation. We’re looking for 3–7 years experience in social media management or content creation.

* Proven experience owning organic strategy across at least two core platforms (e.g. Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn), including a track record of platform-specific content that has driven measurable growth in reach or engagement
* Hands-on experience filming, editing and producing short-form video content, using tools such as CapCut, Canva or Adobe Creative Suite
* Confident working with social analytics and reporting tools, and using performance data to inform content and campaign decisions
* Standout copywriting skills, with an engaging TOV and the ability to write and brief on-brand content across formats
* Highly organised, able to manage a live content calendar and multiple concurrent campaigns end-to-end
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with a track record of working with limited approval cycles
* Happy to be office based in London, working closely alongside the team

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to the CPG, F&B, or drinks industry, either in house or through agency work
* Knowledge of creator outreach and relationship management, from initial contact through to briefing and delivery
* Experience line managing, coaching, or mentoring at least one direct report or junior team member

  
**Benefits**  

* The chance to shape strategy and see your work come to life

* A collaborative, ambitious team and a genuine seat at the table.
* 4 days in the office, 1 day WFH

WELLBEING & PASTORAL SUPPORT: A dedicated buddy and Platform programme manager and access to a range of wellness and mental health initiatives.

Good luck, and do not use AI to generate these answers (we’ll know), and you’ll sound the same as everyone else who does it. This is about you representing you, we care more about your ideas more than what AI thinks you should say.

There will be 200 people attending and you have a budget of £20,000 to spend, please let us know where you’re taking us and a plan of what we’ll be getting up to. It’s very important that you tell us how you’ll use the budget, as we need the Finance team to approve it.

*(This is obviously not a real scenario, but we want to see your ability to plan, present and sell an idea, plus demonstrate how you plan with a budget. We’re not judging the idea itself so go wild, but we are judging how you communicate it and how you manage budgets and resources.)*

You need to think on your feet, please provide us a bullet point breakdown (in order) of what you’ll do.

(We want to see your engagement and interest in what you’re doing. Hundreds of people apply to Platform roles, and our aim is to find the people being the most intentional about what they are applying for. The hiring managers will not see the question unless you want them to, so go as in depth as you like based on what you can find out about them through your research.)

New Business & Marketing Platformer

Havas Media Network are part of the Havas Group, one of the world’s largest communications agencies. Our headquarters are based at Havas Village at King’s Cross/St Pancras, London. Our overarching mission is to make a meaningful difference to the brands, businesses, and lives of the people we work with. Our solution is simple: we identify and create meaningful media experiences to deliver meaningful growth for our clients.

We’re on Campaign’s ‘Best Place to Work’ list each year and our Talent team has been awarded the IPA Gold CPD Accreditation. Havas Media Group is a place where you can make things happen by pursuing your professional and personal dreams.

THE ROLE

As our New Business & Marketing Platformer, you’ll be a junior member of the Growth & Marketing team, supporting both our new business pitches and our marketing activity. You’ll keep our pitches running smoothly behind the scenes, help us show up brilliantly at events and award shows, and make sure the team always has the right information at its fingertips.

Core responsibilities

  

* Pitch support: building timing plan skeletons, diarising catch-ups and rehearsals, booking rooms and helping with logistics and on-the-day support.

* RFI Agent: keeping our RFI Agent tool up to date by uploading the most recent submissions and pitch decks.
* Awards: researching open dates and deadlines for the 2027 awards calendar, diarising check-ins and proofreading entries.
* Marketing events: briefing in marketing collateral, signing guests in and welcoming them on the day.
* Social media: pulling together monthly social reporting and contributing content ideas.
* SharePoint admin: keeping the Growth & New Business SharePoint organised, filing campaign assets and recent pitch material so everything is easy to find.

* Your work will feed directly into live pitches, RFI submissions, award entries, events and our own social channels.

jobs.description:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.
  
  
Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.
  
  
UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.
  
  
As the Senior Product Marketing Manager you will own the narrative for UFORCE products: what each platform is for, whom it serves, and the language that makes both immediately clear. The positioning, messaging frameworks and arguments produced in this role are what the rest of the company works from - sales, press, government relations, the website and the exhibition stand.
  
  
The role is the bridge between the engineers who build the systems and the people who sell them. It requires sustained time with both, and with the operators who use the products, until the technology can be explained effortlessly.
  
  
It also carries custody of that language. The standard is uncompromising: no document that overclaims, no adjective that would not survive a procurement review. The narrative is expected to iterate at the pace of the products.

* Maintain a current assessment of the competitive landscape - the neo-primes, the incumbent primes and the low-cost entrants - and convert it into positioning rather than description.

* Provide PR, communications and government relations with the product substance their work depends on, and ensure claims remain consistent wherever they appear.

* Substantial experience marketing hardware or software within a technology company, including ownership of at least one launch from positioning through to market.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives without loss of accuracy.
* Exceptional writing and editing across registers. Copy for engineers, procurement, investors and press are four distinct disciplines.
* The ability to brief a creative such that the resulting image or video explains a system rather than decorating it.
* A record of cross-functional work with product and engineering teams, and a willingness to keep asking elementary questions until the answer is clear.
* Ability to obtain UK national security clearance if required

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience in defence, dual-use or uncrewed systems, whether in industry or in service
* Experience working with engineering or operational teams remotely
* Complementary skills in design or video

The nature of combat has changed.
  
  
Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.
  
  
And UFORCE is ready.
  
  
Are You?

* Comfort working as a team of one in-region while collaborating closely with a global team across time zones.
* Strong relationships with sales leaders and an instinct for turning field feedback into marketing action.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce or HubSpot and of partner and event attribution.
* Willingness to travel across EMEA.

**⚡️ About Volter**
AI and renewables are the 21st century's two largest megatrends, and they're colliding in the world's largest industry: energy. AI has made intelligence abundant, so human brains are no longer the bottleneck. Cheap and secure power is.
  
  
The people, businesses and countries that have access to cheap, clean and secure power will lead this century. Renewables can deliver it, but they've turned a previously static, predictable commodity into a huge, complex, changing forecasting and optimisation problem that the industry's decades-old systems were never built to solve.
  
  
Volter exists to solve it. We're building the first AI-native operating system for business energy, so that every business can run on power that's cheaper, cleaner and more secure. Octopus and Kraken did this for homes; we're doing it for business.
  
  
And it's working. We launched our platform in early 2026 and have already grown revenue 20x, with customers all across the UK now using the Volter platform. We're still a small team, so you'll shape the product, the tech and the culture from the ground up.
  
  
**🔋 Where you plug in**
Most businesses buy energy through brokers, so winning them over is how we reach thousands more customers. We're hiring our first Marketing Lead to take our brand to market. You come from a product marketing background, and you know how to turn a complex product into content and events people want to show up for.
  
  
Your core job is content and events, done really well. That means expert-led content that makes Volter the voice brokers and businesses trust, and webinars, roundtables and broker events that TPIs want to attend. That work then powers everything around it: the materials our sales team uses, and the programmes our partnerships team runs with brokers.
  
  
A year in, success looks like a clear marketing plan executed really well. Brokers and TPIs come to our events and webinars, our content is something people read and share, and Volter is becoming a name brokers recognise and recommend.
  
  
**⚙️ What You'll Power**
**💡 Content and thought leadership (your core)**

* Know the product, the energy market and our customers (brokers, businesses and generators) inside out.
* Turn what our energy and AI experts know into sharp, useful content: guides, blogs, newsletters and LinkedIn posts.
* Build Volter's voice in the market, and the profile of our founders and experts.
* Own our positioning and messaging, so every piece we publish tells the same clear story.

**🎤 Events and webinars (your core)**

* Run a regular programme of webinars, roundtables and broker events that brokers, businesses and generators want to attend.
* Add real value in the room: presenting, moderating and talking to partners, not just organising.
* Follow up well, so every event turns into relationships and pipeline for the commercial team.

**🤝 What It Enables**

* Sales enablement: turn your content into the broker packs, one-pagers, case studies and pitch materials our sales team uses every week.
* Partnerships: work closely with our partnerships team, giving them the content, events and materials they need to win and grow broker relationships.

Alongside this, you'll own the marketing plan and budget, keep the brand consistent, and report on what's working using HubSpot.
  
  
**🔌 What You'll Bring**

* A product marketing background in B2B, ideally with a complex or technical product. You enjoy getting your head around how things really work.
* A track record of content people actually read. You write it yourself and can turn expert, technical knowledge into something clear and useful.
* You've run webinars, roundtables or events yourself, and you're confident presenting and talking to partners in the room.
* You've created content and materials that sales teams or partners used to win deals.
* You've built something from zero to one, whether as a first marketing hire, by launching a new programme, or by setting up a function from scratch.
* You get stuck in and work things out for yourself, rather than bringing in an agency for everything. You make the most of a lean budget and use AI tools every day.
* You use HubSpot (or a similar CRM) confidently for events, email and reporting. You don't need to have set it up.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience in energy, climate or another technical or regulated market (a real plus: you'll get up to speed much faster)
* Experience marketing through partners or channels such as brokers, resellers or intermediaries
* Contacts in the UK energy trade media

**🔆 Your kind of energy**

* Fun and humble: You're as happy stuffing goodie bags as presenting to founders. You give the experts the credit for the content and celebrate the commercial team's wins.
